scope: fresh isolated audit of the installed Pulp SDK 0.923.0 and current-head Grainfield VST3 bundle

moduleinfo.conclusion: The SDK exposes declarations only. It does not ship moduleinfocreator.cpp, moduleinfoparser.cpp, a generator executable, a moduleinfo CMake target, or creator/parser symbols in libvst3-sdk.a.

validator.conclusion: The SDK includes validator declarations/sample headers only. No supported Steinberg validator implementation or configured build target is installed. Pulp's optional validator name is vstvalidator.

pulp_packaging_path.behavior: _pulp_add_vst3 copies a project-owned moduleinfo.json into Contents/Resources/ when it exists; it does not generate or validate one

layout_check.interpretation: Pulp's layout checker only rejects a misplaced moduleinfo.json; missing metadata is allowed.

manual_generation.decision: Do not add a hand-authored moduleinfo.json in this audit. A source-owned JSON can be copied by Pulp, but without the SDK creator implementation or an official validator its class/factory metadata would be ungenerated and unvalidated.

open_gates: official moduleinfo creator or generator unavailable
current Grainfield bundle has no moduleinfo.json
pluginval remains the available current-head runtime validator; it does not prove moduleinfo metadata
conclusion: No supported or installed tool can generate and validate Grainfield moduleinfo.json from SDK 0.923.0. The safe source-routed action is to preserve the absence as partial and only add a project-owned moduleinfo.json when authoritative metadata and an official validation path are available.
